echoParts: I am am the resurrection and the life
verseText: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live...'
meaning: When we believe in Jesus, we have a promise from him. After we die, we'll live forever with him. When he returns, our bodies will be raised to life.
